title: The Shelf's Buried Answer

features.name: the sinking answer
features.desc-on-touch: you touch what the shelf remembers, and it shifts one layer deeper. the question and answer have swapped places.

features.name: sediment band
features.desc-on-touch: a ring of older stone, reading as time. the archive remembers what it was before the shelf.

features.name: the patient stone
features.desc-on-touch: grey and still, waiting. you rest your hand on it and feel the patience of a hundred years of asking the same question.

features.name: weight
features.desc-on-touch: the shelf's own pressing presence. something is heavy here that cannot be lifted.

inscription: the answer waited so long it became a new question
